The body is in the art style and proportions of the character in image[2]. Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart. Stylized 3D cartoon character, an everyday person rather than an athlete, with a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, smooth matte clay look, a detailed and expressive face, sculpted chunky hair, soft folds in the clothes, and well-defined hands, elbows and knees. The kit: a loose short-sleeved football jersey in plain near-white, pants ending just below the knee in plain mid grey, long socks in plain dark grey, each one flat colour with no logos, no numbers, no text, no stripes and no trim in another colour. Bare arms and bare hands, no helmet, no pads. Mouth closed. Matte, no gloss. Flat, even lighting. Single isolated figure on a plain flat blue-grey background, no floor shadow, no props.
